subject: VMWARE_ESXI

sutProfile.guestDriver: Linux e1000e plus raw PCI config probe
sutProfile.workload: Correctable-only synthetic AER: PassthruIdle eight bits, PassthruActive Receiver and Advisory Non-Fatal representatives, and QEMU 24-row gate positive control

expected: Each requested Correctable bit is evaluated independently from a requested-bit-clean baseline without any Uncorrectable status or non-CED Device Status delta.
Endpoint status deposition, message routing, bounded host/guest observation and recovery are reported as separate outcomes.
When effective endpoint CERE is disabled, message routing is classified as not testable rather than as delivered-and-silenced.
The QEMU positive control distinguishes CERE-blocked, endpoint-masked and route-enabled-with-Root-COR_EN-disabled behavior and checks Correctable Source ID.
observed: All eight PassthruIdle rows deposited exactly the requested Correctable Error Status bit; Receiver and Advisory Non-Fatal also projected into the active guest raw capability body.
Endpoint/root/guest Uncorrectable Error Status remained zero, no non-CED Device Status appeared, and no Root Uncorrectable reception appeared.
Every ESXi row had endpoint CERE disabled; Root CERE and Root COR_EN were also disabled, so ERR_COR delivery, Root service, interrupt and host handling were not tested.

The guest AER Extended Capability header remained zero, _OSC did not grant AER, and captured guest/ESXi log windows contained no matching event; this negative observation is not proof of no internal service.
QEMU 11.0.2 completed 24 of 24 positive-control rows and recorded Root COR_RCV plus the matching Correctable Source only for the CERE-enabled, unmasked route case.
limitations: The endpoint CERE, Root CERE and Root COR_EN gates were disabled in every ESXi row, so route-enabled delivery and host service are not proven.
The raw run directories are external sibling artifacts and are not committed to this repository; their result and manifest digests are pinned here and in the registered summary.

The primary matrix rows used runner hash e12bf9a19e229f7df4006e62dd84e34f18f7d60f8af1578de33105c0d9f4048c; the current runner hash f5c7998fdfaefc8ba2fb82654ec4d7eefa5c1d3f76b64814756cf04ad5aa29fb was live-smoked only with PassthruIdle Receiver after a stale ManagedObject handling fix.
Guest writes to the hidden AER body, T5 clear/reboot/detach/reuse, complete Native-owner coverage and three-run repeatability are not tested.
Synthetic status injection does not reproduce real Bad TLP, Bad DLLP, replay, Header Log queue overflow, electrical link behavior, physical reset cleanliness, health or quarantine.
The observation is limited to one ESXi build, nested q35/OVMF, QEMU e1000e and an EFI Linux guest; it is not Qman product conformance or physical qualification.
